description: This file defines the Session class responsible for managing user sessions within the Goteo application. It handles session initialization, expiry, user data storage, and related session lifecycle events, utilizing Symfony's HTTP Foundation components.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Class for managing user sessions, handling initialization, expiry, user data, and session events within the Goteo application using Symfony components.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Initializes session management with optional Symfony Request object.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves the current session object, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: setSessionExpires
methods.description: Sets the session expiry time in seconds.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the session start time in seconds.

methods.name: getSessionExpires
methods.description: Returns the current session expiry time.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the session start time or current microtime if not set.

methods.name: expiresIn
methods.description: Calculates remaining session time before expiration.

methods.name: renew
methods.description: Updates the init_time to extend the session expiry.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new session with an optional name and session timeout.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the current session ID, handling regeneration if needed.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Invalidates the current session and triggers destruction callback.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the session and legacy $_SESSION.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the session or default.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all session data.

methods.name: getAndDel
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a key from session.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Removes a key from session.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in session.

methods.name: onSessionExpires
methods.description: Sets a callback to execute when session expires automatically.

methods.name: onSessionDestroyed
methods.description: Sets a callback to execute when session is destroyed manually.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Stores a User object in session, optionally setting a persistent cookie.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Returns true if a User is logged in.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Returns true if the logged-in user has admin permissions.

methods.name: isModuleAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the user has admin rights for a specific module.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the logged-in user or false.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User object if logged in, otherwise null.

methods.name: addToMenu
methods.description: Adds an item to specified menu collection.

methods.name: delMenuPosition
methods.description: Removes a menu item at a specific position.

methods.name: addToMainMenu
methods.description: Adds an item to the main menu.

methods.name: addToUserMenu
methods.description: Adds an item to the user menu.

methods.name: addToSidebarMenu
methods.description: Adds an item to the sidebar menu.

methods.name: getMainMenu
methods.description: Retrieves the main menu items.

methods.name: getUserMenu
methods.description: Retrieves the user menu items.

methods.name: getSidebarMenu
methods.description: Retrieves the sidebar menu items.

methods.name: delMainMenuPosition
methods.description: Deletes an entry from the main menu at specified position.

methods.name: delUserMenuPosition
methods.description: Deletes an entry from the user menu at specified position.

methods.name: delSidebarMenuPosition
methods.description: Deletes an entry from the sidebar menu at specified position.
